summary: Interactive OMP, Claude, and Codex agents use the managed launch wrapper selected by their runtime profile, including explicit provider executable overrides

replay.detail: No graph replay; executable selection happens in the driver before launch.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: OMP, Claude, and Codex agent-seat driver launches, including flagless legacy re-exec helpers, use personas.launch.<persona>.harnessBin. Person-owned terminal bindings retain native execution; one authenticated declaration read selects this path, while agent-owned or absent bindings remain managed. Prelaunch capture follows the same rule. Select AGENT_PERSONA when set, otherwise generalist as an internal default without exporting AGENT_PERSONA. Only confirmed declaration not-found permits an absent declaration; classified daemon outages wait without spawning, while other read errors refuse. Provider PATH is prefixed. Before spawn, any present ST_AGENT/FRACTAL_AGENT must equal the fenced subject (including rejecting empty values); both child aliases are then set to that subject. Driver environment and person-owned native sessions are unchanged.

manual.detail: Rollout dependency: do not upgrade a host to a Fractal release containing this change until that host has activated a runtime profile with personas.launch.<persona>.harnessBin for its managed seats. Read an absolute AGENT_RUNTIME_PROFILE when set, otherwise the stable HOME-relative coding-agent-runtime Nix profile; missing profile, persona key, or wrapper refuses new managed launches.

recovery.detail: Correct the runtime profile or install the named wrapper before retrying a refused launch. Prelaunch subscriptions watch the profile and selected wrapper even when resolution fails, so repairing either input re-triggers reconciliation without falling back to a raw provider.
